name: GR-2
summary: Fourier's second-generation humanoid, taller and heavier than GR-1 and built on seven in-house FSA actuator designs with peak torques past 380 N·m. The headline change is the hands: 12 degrees of freedom with six array-type tactile sensors per fingertip that read force and infer an object's shape and material.
notable: Array tactile sensing in the fingertips
Detachable battery with twice GR-1's capacity
